title: A tile's custom range opens its report on the same dates, showing Custom
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • Every tile is on its default range: you have just opened the Dashboard, and no custom range is set.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click the Revenue tile's date pill and, in the calendar, pick a start day and an end day yourself (for example Aug 3, 2026 and Aug 17, 2026).
  3. Click Apply and write down the dates the Revenue pill shows.
  4. Click the report icon beside Revenue.
  5. Read the Sales report's Date control and the dates it covers.
  6. Click Reports in the top bar and, for Sales, Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization and Sales By Customer, open the Date control and write down its choices.
  7. Compare each list with the tile presets: Last 12 Months, This Year, Last Year, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Month, Last Month, This Week, Last Week.
  8. If a report lacks one of those presets, go to the Dashboard, set that report's tile to the missing preset, write down the tile's dates, click the tile's report icon and read the report's Date control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 2 and 3: The calendar lets you pick your own start day and end day, and the Revenue pill then shows those dates (for example Aug 3, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026). If it does not, the case fails.
  • Step 5: The Sales report opens on exactly the dates the tile showed (for example Aug 3, 2026 to Aug 17, 2026).
  • Step 5: Its Date control shows Custom.
  • Step 7: Write down any preset a report lacks. If every report has all nine, step 8 is not needed: write "every preset found" in the result comment.
  • Step 8: The report opens on exactly the tile's dates and its Date control shows Custom.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; stories SV-9582 (Story 10, Report Drill-In) and SV-9579 (Story 7, Per-Tile Date Ranges); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S7-R2a (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 3 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14), S10-R3, S10-E1 and the Story 10 context note on S10-E1 (unchanged since version 41); read 14 Oct 2026. Design canvas board 03_Range_After (the tile's calendar with Apply), used for on-screen labels only. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version was last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R2a: “The control is the same date picker the reports use. Besides the nine presets it offers a calendar for choosing a custom range of up to 366 days, the same limit the reports apply, and a Today button inside the calendar. Today is part of the calendar, not a tenth preset. A custom range is not remembered between visits (S7-R8), and the report opened from the tile shows it as "Custom" (S10-E1).”
  • S10-R3: “The report opens with the date range the tile currently shows.”
  • S10-E1: “If a report does not offer the tile's preset, the report opens with the same dates and its date-range control shows "Custom".”
  • Context note (Story 10, when the Custom fallback is reached): “with S10-R7 in place, every tile preset exists in every linked report, so S10-E1 is reached only if a report's date list changes later.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.
